title: Nalla Kaalam Porandaachu
desc: Thangamuthu, a labourer, struggles to get an eye operation done for his mother, who wishes to see him married and settled down with his family.

title: Kaadhalargal
desc: Unknown to a young man, a girl foils his plans of finding a life partner. Later, he falls in love with the same girl without realising that she was the same person who changed the course of his life.

title: Avasara Police 100
desc: A hardened criminal seeks revenge against his father for abandoning his mother. Soon, he finds a policeman who is a doppelgänger of himself and decides to manipulate him for his motives.

title: Vallakkoattai
desc: Released from prison, Muthu accepts an assignment to earn money for a friend's unwell sibling. However, he soon turns against his crooked employers to shield an innocent village leader.

title: Nallavanukku Nallavan
desc: Gangadharan, a kind man, hires Manickam, a reformed criminal, at his factory, who in time wins his trust and is put in charge of the business. However, Gangadharan's spoiled son is unhappy about it.
